note: Rustic drive-in campground on the northwest corner of 835-acre Big Lake in the Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest; back-in gravel spurs off a paved campground road. The east-side sites along the shore look out on the lake through the pines. The Heart of Vilas County paved bike trail is nearby. --Claude
